title: Approximate tilde on the countdown
description: Drop both the pill and the scheduled prefix. Mark an estimated row with a single green '~' immediately before the countdown ('~4 min') — the universal 'approximate' glyph. Lowest ink of the set; provenance travels with the one number a rider actually reads. Schedule-only rows show no tilde.
baseline_ref: app/components/ArrivalRow.vue: .arrival-row__badge--estimated pill + .arrival-row__scheduled prefix on estimated rows

changes.intent: Prefix the numeric countdown with an approximate marker only when the arrival is estimated.
changes.detail: Remove the .arrival-row__badge--estimated pill and the .arrival-row__scheduled span. Inside .arrival-row__eta, when arrival.estimated and etaMinutes > 0, render a leading ~ before the number (skip it for the 'ahora'/'SALIENDO' states, which have no number).

changes.intent: Tint the tilde with the live/ok token so it reads as a real-time cue, matching the weight of the number it precedes.
